messages:
carmen: Quick coordination note — we're doing the Wed morning deployment wave across staging -> prod. Target window 09:00-11:00 PST. Who's taking ownership for svc-auth, svc-router, and web-ui? Need smoke owners and rollback leads. TL;DR: assign, confirm readiness, and call handoff 10m before your deploy.

kevin: I can own svc-auth. I'll be available 08:50–11:15 PST. Will run smoke and watch auth errors.

alexa: I'll pick up web-ui. Plan: small frontend canary (10%) then full. Smoke owner: me.

raj: I'll do svc-router, but can swap if needed. Need someone to watch inter-service 5xxs during my window.

ben: I can standby for rollback assistance and database connection checks. Add me to the handoff.

sre-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: staging deploys locked for 08:45 PST. Reminder: annotate deploy with #wave-2026 and include monitoring links.

carmen: Great — summary: svc-auth => kevin (smoke + rollback lead: ben), svc-router => raj (smoke watch: alexa), web-ui => alexa (rollback lead: ben). Please post your smoke command/queries below.

kevin: Smoke checks for svc-auth:
```
# basic health
curl -fSs https://staging-auth.redwood.internal/health || echo 'auth-health-fail'
# quick token flow check
curl -s -X POST https://staging-auth.redwood.internal/token -d '{"user":"smoke","pw":"smoke"}' | jq .expires_in
```
I'll also watch the auth latency dashboard (links in #runbooks).

alexa: web-ui smoke: open /app and confirm bundle loads + critical API 200s
```
curl -I https://staging-web.redwood.internal/ | head -n 1  # expect 200
curl -s https://staging-web.redwood.internal/api/status | jq .ok
```
I'll watch real-user metrics in Datadog for JS errors.

raj: router smoke (happy path routing + header propagation):
```
curl -v -H "x-test:smoke" https://staging-router.redwood.internal/route-to/auth | grep x-test
```
If I see >2% 5xxs in 5m window I'll abort and roll back.

carmen: Rollback plan: revert to deployed tag on each service, database migrations are backward-compatible (confirming), and ben will coordinate DB checks. ben can you assert migrations are safe?

ben: Confirmed — migration check passed on a staging snapshot. If we need revert, I'll help coordinate DB connection draining and re-pointing.

kevin: One ask — can we reserve a 5-min pre-window for a smoke rehearsal in staging at 08:50 PST? quick dry-run so we don't discover env issues mid-window.

carmen: Yes — rehearsal at 08:50. Everyone please be on the wave call (link: https://zoom.redwood.com/wave-2026). Call handoff 10m before each deploy, and post a single-line update in this thread when you start and finish.

alexa: noted. I'll post: "web-ui smoke start" / "web-ui smoke done". :white_check_mark:

raj: same for router.

kevin: svc-auth smoke start/done.

sre-bot: Reminder: create incident if SLO breach >5m or if automated monitors trigger >3 alerts during deploy window.

carmen: Perfect — thanks team. If anyone needs to swap ownership, ping me by EOD today.
